items.headline: adidas' Wetherlam boot is built for bad weather
items.caption: A waterproof outdoor boot that looks just as good in town.
body: It uses adidas' Aditex, the brand's own take on Gore-Tex.
It joins the SPZL line of winter boots like the Helvellyn.
How to wear it: with straight-leg cords and a fleece.

items.headline: Luxury brands now sell characters, not uniforms
items.caption: Highsnobiety calls it 'charactermaxxing'.
body: Fashion has moved from signature uniforms like the Chanel suit to whole personalities you can try on.
Louis Vuitton's latest men's pre-collection is one example.
How to wear it: pick a character and commit to it, head to toe.

items.headline: New Balance 991 goes half tweed, half leather
items.caption: A luxe Made in UK dad shoe.
body: Brown tweed under black leather, made at New Balance's England factory.
It's soft and fuzzy in places, sleek in others.
How to wear it: grey flannel trousers and a navy overcoat.

items.headline: Nike's 24.7 boot is basically a sporty UGG
items.caption: A cushioned recovery boot with a rippled heel.
body: Matte leather uppers and lots of padding make it a cosy ankle boot.
Nike made it on its own, not with UGG.
How to wear it: joggers and a hoodie, weekends only.

items.headline: New Balance's 2010 goes Gore-Tex in kingfisher colours
items.caption: A waterproof winter sneaker with Tokyo shop The Apartment.
body: Bright blue, turquoise and orange, inspired by the kingfisher bird.
It's built to handle bad weather and still look good.
How to wear it: let the shoes be the only colour.

items.headline: King Kenny's vintage Carhartt jacket
items.caption: A Carhartt J97 Detroit in 'Moss' stole a scene on The Celebrity Traitors.
body: Short, wide olive canvas with a brown collar.
Vintage Detroit jackets are prized by workwear fans.
How to wear it: over a hoodie with straight jeans.

items.headline: What to wear to a house party
items.caption: GQ's new column dresses you for every kind of party.
body: From warehouse all-nighters to proper dinner parties.
Matching the vibe matters as much as the clothes.
How to wear it: dark trousers, a good knit, clean trainers; adjust up or down.

items.headline: Tom Hardy's guide to wearing jewellery
items.caption: His lesson: restraint.
body: Hardy used to pile on rings, bracelets and beads.
Now he wears a few pieces that each mean something.
How to wear it: one ring, one watch, maybe one chain. Stop there.

items.headline: Jack O'Connell's perfect pub leather jacket
items.caption: Leather that looks lived-in, from red carpet to the bar.
body: Esquire calls him the actor you'd want to go for a pint with.
His jackets look like they have a story.
How to wear it: worn-in leather, plain tee, dark jeans.

items.headline: The Rake's 'Street Smarts' shoot
items.caption: Classic tailoring made for city boulevards.
body: The magazine's Issue 108 fashion story celebrates the 'boulevardier'.
Its idea: a well-dressed man doesn't pose, he just is himself.
How to wear it: a soft-shouldered jacket, open collar, unhurried pace.

items.headline: A couple builds a bench for a girl at their bus stop
items.caption: She'd been sitting in the dirt; their camera caught her jumping for joy.
body: Florida teachers Maren and David Douglass saw a schoolgirl waiting on the ground at the end of their driveway.
With no sidewalk nearby, they installed a bench for her.
Her happy reaction went viral.

items.headline: A vitamin B5 compound may help treat psoriasis
items.caption: Early results show promise for a skin condition with no cure.
body: Researchers in China found pantethine limits immune cells that drive autoimmune disease.
It reduced symptoms in studies with humans and mice.
More research is needed, but it's an encouraging start.

items.headline: Two 88-year-olds fall in love at the gym
items.caption: Both widowed, Barbara and Fred met among the barbells.
body: Barbara Thompson lost her husband and moved to a Birmingham retirement village a decade ago.
Fred Jenkins, a former Army PT instructor, lost his wife three years ago.
They met during a workout and never expected to find love again.
